name: Honeybadger
description: Honeybadger's hosted server reads faults, notices, uptime checks and check-ins.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (app.honeybadger.io) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
